MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
Harborlight Neighbors Alliance and Beacon Community Church
PARTNER ALLIANCE
Beacon Community Church Harborlight Neighbors Alliance
Attn: Laura Burke 7714 N Aspen Way
4706 S Sunrise Dr Suite 363
Tacoma, WA 98485 Tacoma, WA 98483

This Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) sets out how Beacon Community Church and the Alliance will work
together on the Youth Tutoring Collaborative from 27 Jan 2026 through 26 Jan 2028. It is a statement of
cooperation and does not create a binding obligation to pay money.

1. Responsibilities of the Partner

The Partner will make its space available for the program for 10 hours per week, will designate one staff or
volunteer liaison, will help publicize the program to the families and residents it serves, and will keep the space
clean and safe.

2. Responsibilities of the Alliance

The Alliance will provide program staff and trained volunteers, food and supplies, and liability insurance for the
program, will keep attendance records, and will share summary results with the Partner at the review meeting on
27 Jul 2026.

3. Privacy
Each party will keep personal information about participants confidential and will share it only as needed to run
the program. Neither party will use participant information for fundraising without written permission.

4. Term and Ending This MOU
This MOU begins 27 Jan 2026 and ends 26 Jan 2028 unless extended in writing. Either party may end it on 30
days written notice.

5. Independent Parties

The parties are independent organizations. Neither is the agent or employee of the other, and each is responsible
for its own staff, volunteers and insurance. No money passes between the parties under this MOU; any in-kind
support will be recorded separately.
